metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California exceed 23 degrees Celcius on August 1, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: JPL/OCEANS/GHRSST/MUR daily SST (global, ~1 km). Date window: 2018-08-01 to 2018-08-02. Location: small offshore buffer near La Jolla (Scripps Pier).
- Fallbacks: MODIS/061/MYD28D (Aqua daily SST), then MODIS/061/MOD28D (Terra daily SST).
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- These are L4/L3 SST products (no cloud bands). Mask non-physical or fill values using sst > 200 K to keep ocean pixels only.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if zero across all datasets => C1.
- Compute valid pixel count after masking; if zero => C2.
- If mean/max is null/NaN or out-of-range (<-2 C or >45 C) => C3.
- Decision criterion: if max SST (Celsius) > 23 then A: Yes; else B: No.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.257, 32.867]); // Near Scripps Pier, La Jolla
    const region = pt.buffer(3000).bounds(); // ~3 km coastal box
    const start = '2018-08-01';
    const end = '2018-08-02';
    const thresholdC = 23.0;

    // 2. Helper: try datasets in order and pick sst band
    async function tryDataset(datasetId, bandCandidates) {
      try {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region);
        const size = await col.size().getInfo();
        console.log(`${datasetId} Images: ${size}`);
        if (size === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'empty', id: datasetId, size: 0 };
        const img = ee.Image(col.first());
        const bands = await img.bandNames().getInfo();
        // Find first available candidate band
        let chosen = null;
        for (const b of bandCandidates) {
          if (bands.indexOf(b) !== -1) { chosen = b; break; }
        }
        if (!chosen) return { ok: false, reason: 'no_band', id: datasetId, size };
        // Prepare Kelvin SST and mask plausible ocean values
        const sstK = img.select(chosen).updateMask(img.select(chosen).gt(200));
        return { ok: true, id: datasetId, size, img: sstK.rename('sstK') };
      } catch (e) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'error', id: datasetId, error: String(e) };
      }
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Check (Primary + Fallbacks)
    const attempts = [
      { id: 'JPL/OCEANS/GHRSST/MUR', bands: ['sst', 'analysed_sst', 'SST'] },
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD28D', bands: ['sst', 'SST'] },
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD28D', bands: ['sst', 'SST'] },
    ];

    let chosen = null;
    for (const att of attempts) {
      const res = await tryDataset(att.id, att.bands);
      if (res.ok) { chosen = res; break; }
      if (res.reason === 'error') {
        console.log(`Dataset error (${res.id}): ${res.error}`);
      } else if (res.reason === 'no_band') {
        console.log(`Dataset missing SST band (${res.id}).`);
      }
    }

    // Handle empty across all datasets
    if (!chosen) {
      // Check if all were empty
      let allEmpty = true;
      for (const att of attempts) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(att.id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region);
        const size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size > 0) { allEmpty = false; break; }
      }
      if (allEmpty) {
        console.log('All datasets empty for date/region.');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
        return;
      } else {
        console.log('Dataset/band/method issue encountered.');
        console.log('D');
        return;
      }
    }

    console.log(`Chosen Dataset: ${chosen.id} (Images: ${chosen.size})`);

    // 4. Processing & Pixel Count (detect C2)
    const sstC = chosen.img.subtract(273.15).rename('sstC');
    const stats = await sstC.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true })
                              .combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const count = stats ? (stats.sstC_count || 0) : 0;
    const meanC = stats ? stats.sstC_mean : null;
    const maxC = stats ? stats.sstC_max : null;

    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${count}`);
    if (!count || count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    if (meanC === null || maxC === null || isNaN(meanC) || isNaN(maxC)) {
      console.log('Computation returned null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // Basic plausibility check for SST in coastal California
    if (meanC < -2 || meanC > 45 || maxC < -2 || maxC > 45) {
      console.log(`Out-of-range SST detected (MeanC=${meanC}, MaxC=${maxC}).`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`SST Mean (°C): ${meanC.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`SST Max (°C): ${maxC.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Threshold (°C): ${thresholdC.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (maxC > thresholdC) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Unhandled Error: ${String(err)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
